Thanks again for working with us on the offline deployment for the manufacturing floor in Austin. We completed the pre-bake today and want to run a short smoke validation on the isolated appliance next Wednesday before operator sign-off.

Attached is the smoke-deploy checklist we plan to follow (high-level):

- boot appliance in isolated VLAN, no egress
- operator login and local admin key rotation
- model artifact integrity (SHA256) and KV cache sanity run
- simulate a small inference workload (1-2 requests/min for 10 minutes)

Questions for Redwood:
1) Can your on-site operator acceptance criteria include a fast rollback trigger? We want an explicit abort path if model fails validation.
2) Who is the designated custodian for accepting the signed manifest on our side (name + PGP key thumbprint would be ideal)?
3) Any recommended time window where we should pause maintenance tasks on adjacent clusters?

We attached the signed manifest (site-manifest-v1.2.json.sig) and the checklist. Please confirm availability for a 30-minute validation window on Wed Sep 30, 14:00-14:30 CT (21:00-21:30 UTC).

Thanks,

Jake — thanks, this looks sensible. A few quick answers & a couple of requests from our side: 

1) Rollback / abort: yes — we require an explicit abort trigger from the operator console. Our suggested abort flow for the smoke window:
   - operator detects failure -> clicks ABORT on local console -> local supervisor process stops the runtime and reverts to the last-known-good image stored in the sealed partition (takes ~90s).
   - operator sends a single-line incident note to custody@altsystems.io and CCs redwood-airgap@redwood.ai (we'll reconcile logs).

2) Custodian: can you confirm who on Alt Systems will perform the manifest acceptance? We will require the custodian name + an RSA key thumbprint (we support RSA and ED25519) included in the acceptance message so our staging runner can auto-verify.

3) Maintenance window: recommend pausing any scheduled backups or storage maintenance on the adjacent clusters for the 30-minute window plus a 15-minute buffer on either side. That avoids IO noise during the KV cache warm-up.

Operational asks for the validation:
- Please ensure the signed manifest is timestamped and includes a build_id and image_digest (SHA256).
- Bring the operator console USB with the HSM token (if you use a hardware token) and test it during preflight.
- We will run a short certificate chain verification step — please have the CA cert bundle available locally.

We're available for the proposed slot. Mina, Ben — can you help with the local runbook and observer role? I'll coordinate the log capture and the verification script.

Regards,
David Kim
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0124
